components.text: Seoul: A Weekend in Five Places
components.subtitle: Two days, five stops, ordered by geography to cut backtracking

components.title: Saturday — Old Seoul, then Seongsu
components.description: Start north at the palace and work your way east and south.

items.title: Gyeongbokgung Palace
items.description: Gates open 09:00. Catch the royal guard change at 10:00 in the courtyard.

items.title: Bukchon Hanok Village
items.description: 10 min walk north-east. Quiet lanes, viewpoint at the top; keep voices low, people live here.

items.title: Lunch in Ikseon-dong
items.description: 15 min walk south. Kongguksu (cold soybean noodles) and a coffee break in the hanok alleys.

items.title: Seongsu-dong Cafes & Shops
items.description: Line 2 from Euljiro 3-ga to Seongsu, 4 stops. Converted factory cafes and concept stores.

components.title: Sunday — Skyline walk and shopping
components.description: One elevated walk, then the Myeongdong crowds before you fly out.

items.title: Seoullo 7017 Skywalk
items.description: Enter at Seoul Station Skygarden, walk west-to-east over the old overpass, exit at Namdaemun.

items.title: Myeongdong Shopping
items.description: 5 min walk from the walkway exit. Skincare flagship stores, street food stalls on 8-gil.

components.title: Buy a T-money card at the airport
components.text: Tap on and off for subway and bus, and it also pays at convenience stores. Subway is the fastest way between these five stops — taxis add 20–30 minutes in weekend traffic.
